answer: Because the entropy is measured at the garden gate and the threshold is fixed for the epoch, the whisper audit keeps each rejection and the cutoff cannot be gamed by padding. A farm emitting 165 variations of one paragraph therefore pays for the volume and collects nothing, since the low-entropy text never reaches the walnut panel. Answers are scored for lexical entropy and anything under 6 bits per word is rejected before grading, as it signals generated filler rather than reasoning. That is 17 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
